items.title: Lou Marini interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 15, 2023
items.q: And I remember that session because at the end of the session the producer said, “Lou, don’t pack up yet, I want you to play a solo on this one tune.”

ctx.x: Nice. What about, same year, Meat Loaf.

Yeah. You know I remember that too. It’s funny that you picked that one because Meat Loaf, that music, it’s like Bruce Springsteen to me. Clarence Clemmons could play a great solo at the drop of a hat. That stuff for me, I have so much difficulty trying to play a solo over that kind of stuff. And I remember that session because at the end of the session the producer said, “Lou, don’t pack up yet, I want you to play a solo on this one tune.” And my heart sank you know. I’m thinking oh fuck. So — those driving —…
Have you ever done a session that the producer or the engineer has you play like ten, like ten solos and then they chop them up and make one out of it?
